analyst.summary: Devyani (KFC/Pizza Hut/Costa Coffee franchisee) continues to grow revenue at a healthy pace but is not yet consistently profitable - it posted a net loss for FY26 and thin net margins in the latest quarter. The pending all-stock merger with Sapphire Foods will reshape the company into India's largest QSR franchise platform over the next 12-18 months, but that also means today's standalone financial history is a poor guide to what the combined business will look like. We rate it a Hold: real growth, but profitability and merger-integration execution both still need to be proven.
